accommodation.notes: A ceiling, not a measured price: the 8% to 20% of ordinary wage that MOEL's guideline allowed for employer housing, on the 2026 minimum monthly wage (10,320 x 209 h = 2,156,880). Typical is the midpoint (14%). MOEL moved to market-based rents in 2023; the current cap was not confirmed.

source.publisher: Ministry of Employment and Labor (Korea), press release of 5 July 2023

other_sources.publisher: Korea.net, minimum wage 2026 and 2027, article of 15 July 2026
HRD Korea, notice on deducting food and lodging from foreign workers

food.notes: Study in Korea's monthly meal estimate for an international student (page of June 2024); typical is the midpoint. It is a student budget, not a measured worker average. Where the employer serves meals, the cost comes through a deduction instead.

source.publisher: Study in Korea (Korean Ministry of Education), living expenses, page of June 2024

transport.notes: Study in Korea's monthly transport estimate; typical is the midpoint. Check: 52 journeys at the Seoul card base fare of 1,550 is 80,600. A worker living at the workplace may spend less.

source.publisher: Study in Korea (Korean Ministry of Education), living expenses, page of June 2024

other_sources.publisher: Seoul Metropolitan Government, subway fares (from 28 June 2025)

phone_data.notes: KT Welcome prepaid for foreign customers, 30 days with 200 minutes: 1 GB at 35,000, 3 GB at 45,000, 5 GB at 55,000. A worker with a residence card can take a cheaper contract plan; those prices were not read.

source.publisher: KT Global Shop, LTE Welcome Prepaid

mandatory_deductions.notes: Worker's share in 2026: pension 4.75%, health 3.595% (half of 7.19%), long-term care 0.4724% (half of 0.9448%), employment insurance 0.9%. Low leaves out the pension, which a worker whose country gives Koreans no equal cover is excluded from. Income tax not checked.

source.publisher: 4 Social Insurance Information Centre (Korea), premium calculator, 2026 rates

other_sources.publisher: National Pension Service, contribution rates (July 2026 to June 2027)
National Pension Service, foreigners and the lump-sum refund (reciprocity)
National Health Insurance Service, contribution rate 2026

residence_card.notes: Issuance fee of the foreign residence card, 35,000 from 1 January 2025 (30,000 before). A foreigner must register within 90 days of arrival.

source.publisher: Korea Immigration Service, fee increase for foreign residence cards (posted 14 December 2024)

transport_card.notes: A T-money card at a convenience store: 2,500 to 5,000 by design (gogohanguk, May 2026); Visit Seoul gives 3,000 for the standard card, an older page. The balance is spent on rides.

source.publisher: GoGoHanguk, guide to Korea's transport cards, article of 20 May 2026

return_cost_insurance.notes: Insurance an E-9 worker pays for the flight home, 400,000 to 600,000 by country (EPS page for the Philippines); typical is the midpoint. The page's pension and health rates are older than 2026, so check this figure. A casualty policy is a small yearly cost, not counted.

source.publisher: Employment Permit System (EPS, Korea), insurance for E-9 workers
